thread:
alex: Quick follow-up from the postmortem earlier today — we still need concrete owners and deadlines for the alert tuning actions (dedupe, threshold tuning, runbook updates, and paging policy). Proposed assignments below. Please ack or reassign. TL;DR: try to have PRs or runbook drafts by EOW.

alex: Proposed items:
- Dedupe rule for model-serving-500s -> owner: samira -> target: 2026-05-08
- Adjust CPU spike threshold on kafka-consumer alert -> owner: zach -> target: 2026-05-03
- Runbook update + paging escalations -> owner: nina -> target: 2026-05-05
- Add prefix KV cache metric to alert set (reduce noise) -> owner: alex -> target: 2026-05-04

samira: taking the dedupe rule. I'll open a draft PR today and add tests. :thumbsup:

zach: can take the cpu threshold but want to run a two-week quiet window first. Will push a canary change and monitor. ETA Mon.

nina: runbook update — can pair with ops tomorrow. I'll add clear rollback steps and add link to postmortem.

oncall-bot: Incident #2026-204 linked: https://redwood.ops/incidents/2026-204 — related to duplicate pages from model-serving-500

samira: draft PR: https://git.redwood/inferops/pagerules/123

alex: example dedupe policy I want in the PR (pseudo):
```
match: "model-serving-500"
window: 600s
group_by: instance, cluster
suppress_if: count>3 AND rate<5/s
route: single-pager
```

zach: re: cpu threshold — what's current? (alex)

alex: current is 70% sustained over 5m. proposing 85% for kafka-consumer for autoscale noise reductions.

nina: ack. will add paging escalation matrix and test steps.

alex: Thanks — I'm adding these to the postmortem follow-up board and will ping owners if no PRs by EOW. :eyes:

zach: noted. will post monitored metrics after canary.

samira: ack and assigning reviewer (nina)

nina: assigning reviewer now. closing loop once runbook PR merged.

alex: any blockers? If not, closing this thread in 48h and surfacing overdue items to leadership.

zach: no blockers from my side.

samira: none.

nina: none.
